name: Odaiba
description: Odaiba from open data, lit by the real sun: the Rainbow Bridge over the bay, the seaside park's beach and its Statue of Liberty, Fuji TV's sphere, and the Yurikamome's guideway across the islands.

imagery.attribution: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) seamless aerial photographs (GSI terms of use, source attribution)

terrain.attribution: GSI Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A, 5 m airborne laser survey bare earth (GSI terms of use); 10 m DEM where 5A is absent

terrain_check.name: GSI elevation API (1 m laser DEM where flown, otherwise DEM5)

plateau.attribution: MLIT Project PLATEAU Tokyo 23 wards LOD2 building models (CC BY 4.0), as vector tiles by indigo-lab (MIT)

seawall.note: The rivers' and the bay's revetments and the castle moats: granite blocks and concrete.

trees.note: Species are not mapped; the mix is a guess: elms and plane trees for the parks and streets, and palms for the seaside park's promenade.

tour.title: Odaiba, from open data
tour.text: {buildings} buildings. {share:plateau}% of the footprint area stands at a height Project PLATEAU surveyed, on islands made in the bay.

tour.title: The Rainbow Bridge
tour.text: 1993: 798 m, a 570 m main span between towers 126 m high, the expressway on top and the Yurikamome below.

tour.title: The seaside park
tour.text: The beach, the Statue of Liberty, and Fuji TV's titanium sphere behind them.

sources.landmarks: The Rainbow Bridge (Metropolitan Expressway, Port of Tokyo: 798 m, main span 570 m, towers 126 m) on OpenStreetMap's line of the expressway, its deck heights from published clearances; Fuji TV's sphere (32 m across) on the FCG building's footprint at about its height; the Statue of Liberty replica (2000, 12.25 m; Minato City) at OpenStreetMap's position; the Yurikamome's guideway on OpenStreetMap's line.

night.note: The Rainbow Bridge's towers and cables are lit landmark meshes (city.py); the streets' lamps are the country's defaults.

game.title: Odaiba on Foot
game.blurb: Walk Odaiba under the real sun: along the seaside park's beach to the Statue of Liberty, under Fuji TV's sphere, and out to see the Rainbow Bridge lit over the bay.

npcs.name: Yui 結衣
idle: Welcome to Odaiba! Twenty years ago this was empty reclaimed land. Now: a TV station, beaches, malls and a bridge.
The Yurikamome has no driver. Sit in the front seat and you're the driver. {time}.

npcs.name: Kenta 健太
idle: No swimming most of the year, but you can paddle. The sand was brought in by boat.
In summer there are fireworks over the bay. The whole beach sits and waits. {sun_line}

npcs.name: Mika 美香
idle: Everybody takes the same picture: Liberty, the bridge, the sunset. I've taken it four hundred times.
Wait for the bridge's lights. They come on at dusk, all at once.

npcs.name: Shun 駿
idle: The Yurikamome loops over the Rainbow Bridge to get up to its deck. Watch the view from the front.
Odaiba was built as a fort, in 1853, against the American ships. The old batteries are islands now.

quests.title: Odaiba
talk: Welcome to Odaiba! Look up: the sphere on the TV station, the bridge across the water.
Go down to the beach. Kenta patrols it; he'll show you the bay.

quests.title: The beach
talk: Sand from a quarry, water from the bay, and the city on the other side. Not bad.
Walk along to the Statue of Liberty. Mika's always there with her camera.

quests.title: The Rainbow Bridge
talk: Now look at the bridge. Wait till the lights come on.
You can walk across it, on the footpath under the expressway. Thirty minutes to Shibaura.

quests.title: The sphere
talk: Fuji TV's sphere: they built a ball into a building, and you can stand inside it.
Go and look at it from below. It's bigger than you think.

steps.text: Look up at Fuji TV's sphere
